We present to you the most special Wilson Padel racket of the entire season, the WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ model, a racket with total maneuverability. It is Momo González's own model. One of the technologies it offers us is its double and reinforced Y-BEAM bridge, which helps us achieve better balance and reduce vibrations. It is a great padel racket to reduce arm discomfort.
